meta.title: Dirty Cut — men's & women's haircuts | Novi Sad
meta.description: Dirty Cut is a unisex hair salon in Novi Sad, Serbia: men's and women's cuts, fades, beards, colouring, highlights and formal styling. Bulevar Jovana Dučića 39D. Book via WhatsApp or Instagram.

about.title: Concrete. Steel. Character.
about.p1: Dirty Cut is a unisex hair salon in Novi Sad. Men and women sit in the same chair and get the same thing: a cut designed for them, not copied from a catalogue.
about.p2: Raw concrete, red curtains and greenery — the space is rough on the outside and precise on the inside. Just like a good fade.
about.imgAlt: Burgundy barber chair at Dirty Cut
